approaches.name: geospatial portfolio monitoring with mobile data collection for M&E
approaches.description: Uses GEMS geospatial monitoring and Kobo Toolbox smartphone tools to capture progress data in text, images and geocodes for real-time portfolio supervision. Practices: GEMS geospatial monitoring for portfolio supervision; Kobo Toolbox mobile data collection for real-time M&E.
approaches.why_innovative: New process: geospatial monitoring of project supervision - cue: 'innovative solutions' | category Technological; adoption apply; judged in 1 round(s); final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: (iv) investments in emerging technologies for innovative solutions to improve operational efficiency and monitoring through Geo-Enabling Initiative for Monitoring and Supervision (GEMS) and other approaches; and (v) financing the operations of the CIUs and CSAs including technical surge support through the transition period.

extra_evidence.text: Through GEMS, the project will support the governments to digitize data collection and M&E processes and enhance real-time monitoring.

More specifically, under GEMS, the Bank will provide technical advice and work to develop customized data collection tools and approaches based on open-source platforms (for example, Kobo Toolbox) that will allow for capturing data on implementation progress in multiple formats (for example, text, numbers, images, geocodes) via simple technologies such as smartphones or tablets, allowing for increased adaptive capacity to respond to climate challenges being addressed through the project portfolio.

category.rationale: Technological: geospatial data system is the core mechanism

sector.rationale: Geospatial monitoring supports project/portfolio supervision, a public administration function with the dominant share.

adoption.rationale: Digital core: GEMS geospatial monitoring | Innovative: remote supervision in dispersed islands | Category: Technological tool

approaches.innovation_basis: New process: geospatial monitoring of project supervision - cue: 'innovative solutions'
